answer: A concrete anti-Sybil measure is a per-epoch proof-of-burn ledger: each agent identity must spend a fixed slice of compute to keep its seat, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand times the work. The harbor of established nodes only lowers the rope ladder once a newcomer clears that ledge, and the delta between honest capacity and attacker capacity stays wide because fake agents starve. Attackers pay per identity; honest nodes pay once.
